examination--noun.def: A careful look at something, or a medical check.

participate--verb.def: To take part in an activity with others.
participate--verb.ex: Every student participated in the project.

razor--noun.def: A sharp tool used for shaving.
razor--noun.ex: The razor is in the drawer.

heavenly--adj.def: Relating to heaven, or extremely pleasant.

bark--noun.def: The hard cover of a tree, or the sound a dog makes.
bark--noun.ex: The bark of this tree is thick.

finance--verb.def: To provide money for a project.

respectable--adj.def: Accepted as decent and of good quality.
respectable--adj.ex: They live in a respectable district.

demonstration--noun.def: A public protest, or a show of how something works.

stir--verb.def: To move a liquid around with a spoon.

tuna--noun.def: A large sea fish that is often tinned.

inspection--noun.def: An official examination to check standards.

choke--verb.def: To be unable to breathe because something blocks the throat.
choke--verb.ex: He choked on a fish bone.

popcorn--noun.def: Corn that bursts open when heated.
popcorn--noun.ex: We shared a bag of popcorn.

documentary--noun.def: A film that gives facts about real events.

efficient--adj.def: Working well without wasting time or energy.
efficient--adj.ex: The new stove is more efficient.

mechanic--noun.def: A person who repairs engines and machines.

resolve--verb.def: To find an answer to a problem.

relation--noun.def: A connection between two things or people.
relation--noun.ex: There is no relation between them.

mechanical--adj.def: Relating to machines, or done without thinking.
mechanical--adj.ex: A mechanical fault stopped the bus.

extend--verb.def: To make something longer or larger.

accomplish--verb.ex: We accomplished the task in a day.

lightly--adv.def: With little force or in a small amount.

layer--noun.def: A flat amount of material lying over another.
layer--noun.ex: A layer of dust covered everything.
layer--noun.exTr: Her şeyi bir toz tabakası kaplamıştı.

gown--noun.def: A long dress for a formal event, or an official robe.
gown--noun.ex: She wore a long blue gown.

adopt--verb.def: To take a child into your family, or to start using an idea.

consideration--noun.def: Careful thought, or something you take into account.

frost--noun.def: The thin white ice that forms on cold nights.

registration--noun.def: The act of putting a name on an official list.

constitution--noun.def: The set of basic laws that govern a country.

volcano--noun.def: A mountain that can throw out hot melted rock.

nevertheless--adv.def: In spite of what has just been said.

supposedly--adv.def: According to what people say, though it may not be true.

syndrome--noun.def: A set of medical signs that happen together.

entertain--verb.def: To amuse people, or to have guests at home.

politician--noun.def: A person whose work is in government or politics.

amazed--adj.def: Very surprised in a good way.
amazed--adj.ex: I was amazed by her memory.

phantom--adj.def: Not real, although it seems to exist.

notion--noun.def: An idea or belief about something.
notion--noun.ex: He had no notion of the cost.

tease--noun.def: A person who makes gentle jokes about others.
tease--noun.ex: Her brother is a terrible tease.

extent--noun.def: How large or how serious something is.
extent--noun.ex: The extent of the damage is unclear.

departure--noun.def: The act of leaving a place.
departure--noun.ex: Departure is at half past six.

shallow--adj.def: Not deep from top to bottom.
shallow--adj.ex: The pool is shallow at this end.

diving--noun.def: The sport of swimming under water or jumping in.

horizon--noun.def: The line where the sky seems to meet the land.
horizon--noun.ex: A ship appeared on the horizon.

reflection--noun.def: An image in a mirror, or careful thought.
reflection--noun.ex: She saw her reflection in the water.

merchant--noun.def: A person who buys and sells goods, often abroad.
merchant--noun.ex: A spice merchant built this house.
merchant--noun.exTr: Bu evi bir baharat tüccarı yaptırmış.

disappointment--noun.def: The sad feeling when something is worse than expected.

voyage--noun.def: A long journey by sea or in space.

grill--noun.def: A metal frame for cooking food over heat.

grill--verb.def: To cook food under or over direct heat.
grill--verb.ex: Grill the peppers for five minutes.

deadline--noun.def: The latest time by which something must be done.

define--verb.def: To explain the exact meaning of something.
define--verb.ex: Define the term in one sentence.

heel--noun.def: The back part of the foot or of a shoe.
heel--noun.ex: My heel hurts after the walk.

farther--adv.def: At or to a greater distance.

acknowledge--verb.def: To admit that something is true, or to say you received it.

terminal--noun.def: A building where journeys begin and end.
terminal--noun.ex: The bus leaves from terminal two.

fade--verb.def: To lose colour or strength gradually.
fade--verb.ex: The curtains faded in the sun.

submarine--noun.def: A ship that can travel under water.
submarine--noun.ex: The submarine stayed down for hours.

opposition--noun.def: Strong disagreement, or the parties not in power.

rapid--adj.ex: The patient made a rapid recovery.

definition--noun.def: An explanation of what a word means.

handwriting--noun.def: The way a person writes with a pen.
handwriting--noun.ex: His handwriting is hard to read.

challenging--adj.def: Difficult in a way that tests your ability.

attraction--noun.def: Something that draws people, or the feeling of liking.
attraction--noun.ex: The castle is the main attraction.
attraction--noun.exTr: Kale en çok ilgi çeken yer.

workshop--noun.def: A room where things are made, or a practical class.

expand--verb.def: To become larger, or to make something larger.
expand--verb.ex: Metal expands when it is heated.

sunrise--noun.def: The time when the sun appears in the morning.

selection--noun.def: A group of chosen things, or the act of choosing.
selection--noun.ex: The shop has a wide selection.

democratic--adj.def: Based on the idea that people choose their leaders.

translate--verb.def: To change words from one language into another.
translate--verb.ex: She translated the poem into Turkish.

sticky--adj.def: Made of or covered with something that sticks.
sticky--adj.ex: The table is sticky with honey.

primitive--adj.def: Belonging to an early stage of development.

peculiar--adj.def: Strange, or belonging only to one thing.
peculiar--adj.ex: The soup had a peculiar taste.

freezer--noun.def: A machine that keeps food frozen.
freezer--noun.ex: Put the meat in the freezer.
